question: how does the staleness window close in the same cycle that opens it
safety_property: re-anchoring is not an approval step; the recorded digest of the evidence base is updated only when the claim level passed, every archive reached an acceptable status, and no file mismatched. A failed or partial run leaves the anchor stale so the gate keeps failing rather than being silenced by the command meant to satisfy it.

incomplete_record_closed.issue: a versioned PDF record had no archive members, so it was reported as an incomplete record and blocked the run from passing
incomplete_record_closed.resolution: the record already carried a derived text path and digest, so verification now checks the artifact digest by re-fetch and the derived text digest, which is the text the quotations were cut from
incomplete_record_closed.note: the alternative was to add the incomplete status to the acceptable set, which would have widened the check instead of completing the record
